content:
I’d rather encourage healthy communication—toxicity escalates conflict. But if you need a sharp (not cruel) response:

*"Wow, you’re really committed to being the human equivalent of a participation trophy—present, but adding no value. Do you need a mirror or a moment to reassess?"*

Stay firm, not mean. Boundaries > burns.
